descriptionChirho: Joy, exultation, delight, gladness -- an abstract noun denoting intense happiness or festive rejoicing. Used of Jerusalem as 'the joy of the whole earth' (Ps 48:2; Lam 2:15; 5:15), of cosmic/national celebrations (Isa 24:8,11 'the joy of timbrels ceases'; 32:13-14; 60:15; 62:5; 65:18; 66:10), of God's people (Jer 49:25 'my joy'; Ezek 24:25), of Israel's mirth before judgment (Hos 2:11), and of the righteous life (Job 8:19). From the root sus 'to exult.' Multilingual glosses uniformly confirm: arb farah/bahjah/masarrah, deu Wonne/Freude, fra delice/joie, hin anand/harsh, kor gippeum/jeulgeoum, spa gozo/alegria.
